brief:
Neuroscientist Yoav Litvin and historian Ilan Pappé discussed how Zionism manipulates fear as a tool for territorial expansion, Zeteo reported. The pair examined whether neurological patterns can explain the ideology's appeal and persistence among Israeli society.

The conversation centered on whether a change in Israeli government would materially improve conditions for Palestinians. Litvin and Pappé suggested structural factors rooted in the settler-colonial project may persist regardless of which political coalition holds power.
dek: Yoav Litvin and Ilan Pappé talk to Mehdi about how Zionism manipulates fear, and whether anything will change for Palestinians even if Israel forms a new government.
title: Scholars argue Zionism exploits fear to justify settler colonialism
